summary: Targeted frontend re-test of the HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW gaps reported in iteration_1 on The Notice Board (public preview URL). All 8 requested items verified via Playwright: detail Apply button (both application_url and anchor-fallback variants), Report trigger + full report dialog submit flow (POST /api/report + success toast + dialog close), quick-filter-* testids on Home, header-saved-count badge, bt-tab-tenders/rfqs/funding with URL ?cat= updates and re-filtering, Command Palette open/close with zero Radix a11y console warnings, plus regressions (universal search -> /discover?q=, Discover category filter 12->1 and clear-filters restore, save toggle, saved page listing, preferences save). Backend suite skipped per request. 0 console errors across all runs.

design_issues.screen: Preferences (and any page showing a sonner toast)
issues: Success toast renders top-centre and overlaps the sticky header nav links ('Business & Tenders', 'Trust & Safety') and the search box, briefly blocking those controls. Consider top-right or offsetting below the header.

action_items: Optional (low): reposition sonner toaster so it does not overlay the sticky header nav/search.
critical_code_review_comments: OpportunityDetail.jsx: the no-application_url fallback renders an <a href='#how-to-apply'> styled as a button — verified it scrolls/updates hash, but if opp.application_instructions is absent the #how-to-apply section is not rendered and the button becomes a no-op. Consider falling back to the WhatsApp help CTA in that case.

OpportunityDetail.jsx is ~270 lines with the ReportDialog inlined; extracting ReportDialog into its own component would improve reuse (report is also triggerable from the Safety section via data-testid='report-btn').
seed_data_creation: One report record created via POST /api/report for opp-005 (reason 'Suspected scam', details prefixed TEST_, contact qa@example.test). Preferences record saved with contact qa@example.test. Saved opportunities stored in browser localStorage only.
test_credentials: No auth in app; /app/memory/test_credentials.md not required
context_for_next_testing_agent: Correct card testids: opportunity cards are 'opportunity-card-{id}' (NOT 'opp-card-'), Business & Tenders cards are 'tender-card-{id}'. Discover filters: filter-cat-{key}, filter-prov-*, filter-exp-*, filter-remote, filter-closing-soon, clear-filters, sort-{key}. Preferences: pref-cat-*, pref-prov-*, pref-save, pref-contact. Only 2 of 12 seeded opportunities have application_url (so most detail pages show the 'See how to apply' anchor variant of detail-apply-button). BT tabs map tenders->cat=tender, rfqs->cat=rfq, funding->cat=business, each currently returning 1 card with the seeded dataset.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all iteration_1 gaps confirmed fixed; no defects reproduced.
